name: What is the typical timeline for a commercial construction project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a commercial construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a commercial construction project varies significantly based on its size, complexity, and specific requirements. Smaller tenant improvements might take a few months, while ground-up new builds can range from 9 to 18 months or even longer. Key factors influencing duration include design approvals, permitting processes in areas like Los Angeles, material procurement, and the construction phase itself. We work with clients to establish realistic schedules and manage expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Timelines vary from months for small improvements to over a year for new builds, depending on project size, complexity, and permitting processes.
